## Final addendum -- last subagent wound down

### Closes
- dying-dietary-bass (bc5d-ffba-006b-4241) CLOSED, verify-signature --kind completion-verifier -> certified. NINTH certified close this session. Closed --ref fafe25e0d1abfbade07d22c51f599672e7ac1707 (the LATER of its two referencing commits; 77fc1b99 is its ancestor, so the verified tree carries both). The file_impact union trap resolved to a no-op -- fafe25e0 touched only the workflow file 77fc1b99 had introduced -- so NO set-file-impact call was made and the attestation's material stayed intact.
- seagreen-fortuitous-crayfish (f449-be6a-be56-4fef) NOT closed, correctly. The attestation-laundering gate refused it: the AC3 provenance justification NAMED the two live test symbols, which makes a [non-codebase] criterion look repo-verifiable. Remedy (on the ticket) is to split AC3 -- repo-verifiable half untagged, external outcome tagged -- which is a material edit needing a fresh 15-20 min review-plan. NOT forced. Close class already decided: preexisting.
  WARNING for whoever resumes it: 3b92fad7 is a BAD --ref pin. run_differs.py and test_dc_rich_text_live.py both changed on main AFTER the fix, so a review pinned there goes stale-code immediately. Its earned plan-review PASS is at --ref ae4f6c1a.

### New ticket filed
feldspar-extinct-sambar (79a4-eae7-e5c7-4713), P2, discovered_from f449: deleting the refresh_scoped_snapshot(ctx) call at run_differs.py:237 SURVIVES the entire 3637-test reconciler suite. The overlay's BEHAVIOUR is well covered (5 tests kill a behaviour mutant, with an anchored clobber pair and a negative control) but its WIRING is not -- only the live DC lane catches the deletion. That asymmetry is the trap: a well-tested module reads as protected while its single invocation is unguarded. Acute right now because several src/rebar modules are being split for module-size reasons, and extraction is exactly the operation that drops call sites.

### Two smaller findings
- WRONG ADR CITATION in shipped source: 'ADR 0037 s3' appears in f449's body and TWICE in snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py's docstring. ADR 0037 is oss-contribution-intake-posture; the real support is docs/adr/0055-jira-family-sub-seam.md:282. Folded into 79a4's description to fix in the same change.
- ENVIRONMENT TRAP: FORCE_COLOR=3 exported in the operator shell makes 21 tests/interfaces CLI-help tests fail spuriously on ANSI codes; unset, all 121 pass. Same class as the anthropic-1.2.0 venv artifact -- an environment condition that reads as repository evidence. Unset it before any suite run.

### Machine state, final
Zero processes remain from any subagent (the last one killed three of its own waiter loops that were spinning on a condition that could never fire -- the same never-fires pattern seen five times tonight). No unpushed commits outstanding. /Users/joeoakhart/rebar on main, clean apart from the two pre-existing reb-3115-*.py untracked files.
